# SymbolicUncertaintiesSlate.jl
> Interactive Kaimon Slate notebooks for SymbolicUncertainties.jl — purely symbolic propagation of measurement uncertainty under JCGM 100:2008 (GUM), from a first `±` to compiled C, with every quantity carrying its unit.
